item: Hose repair kit carried in suit pockets on every EVA
rationale: An experimental pressurised suit's air hose tore on a sharp ATV rail edge during transit on EVA 01 and was cut, patched and pressure-tested in the field. The brief's lesson is to carry a hose repair kit in suit pockets on every EVA.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 536-541, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; Flashline corroboration: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 EVA REPORT-01 08-07-2024 (torn air hose cut and patched in the field)
